title: SceneJail: Exploiting Video Scenario Context to Jailbreak Multimodal LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2609.38899v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Video Multimodal Large Language Models (Video-MLLMs) support reasoning over video inputs, yet remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that elicit policy-violating responses. Existing video jailbreaks primarily manipulate how harmful queries are visually presented, thereby treating video merely as a carrier. Consequently, the surrounding video scenario remains unexplored as a contextual attack surface. In this paper, we show that the same harmful query can elicit different safety responses when placed in different video scenarios.   To systematically exploit this vulnerability, we propose SceneJail, an adaptive black-box jailbreak framework with two coordinated components. Adaptive Scenario Construction dynamically searches for a surrounding scenario that is contextually compatible with the harmful query. Scenario-aware Prompt Search uses black-box response feedback to search for textual guidance tailored to the selected scenario. Extens

translated_title: SceneJail：利用视频场景上下文越狱多模态大语言模型
translated_abstract: 视频多模态大语言模型（Video-MLLMs）支持对视频输入进行推理，但仍然容易受到诱导其产生违反策略响应的越狱攻击。现有的视频越狱方法主要通过操纵有害查询的视觉呈现方式，从而仅仅将视频视为载体。因此，视频的周围场景作为一种上下文攻击面仍未被探索。在本文中，我们表明相同的有害查询在置于不同的视频场景中时会引发不同的安全响应。为了系统地利用这一漏洞，我们提出了SceneJail，一个具有两个协同组件的自适应黑盒越狱框架。自适应场景构建（Adaptive Scenario Construction）动态搜索与有害查询在上下文上兼容的周围场景；场景感知提示搜索（Scenario-aware Prompt Search）利用黑盒响应反馈来搜索针对所选场景定制的文本引导。
tldr: 该论文首次揭示了视频周围场景上下文本身可作为越狱Video-MLLMs的攻击面，并提出SceneJail自适应黑盒框架，通过动态构建与有害查询兼容的场景和场景感知的提示搜索来利用这一漏洞。
en_tdlr: SceneJail reveals that the surrounding video scenario context itself is an unexplored attack surface for jailbreaking Video-MLLMs, proposing an adaptive black-box framework that dynamically searches contextually compatible scenarios and scenario-tailored textual prompts.
